metaDescription: Convert numbers to scientific or engineering notation and expand 6.02e23 to a full decimal, exactly. Free.
intro: Writes numbers as a coefficient times a power of ten (scientific and engineering), and expands notation such as 6.02e23 or 1.5 x 10^-3 into decimals.
why:
Very large and very small numbers are easier to read as a power of ten. Calculators show 6.02E23 while a paper may say 6.02 x 10^23.

Digits are processed as text, so nothing is rounded. Engineering notation uses exponents that are multiples of three, matching SI prefixes.
howTo: Enter one number or notation per line.
Read scientific, engineering and decimal forms.

faq.a: Plain numbers, 6.02e23, 6.02 x 10^23 and 6.02 times 10^23 with the times sign.
Scientific notation where the exponent is a multiple of 3.
